name: Hybrid Vector Quantization
definition: A hybrid compression scheme that applies VQ to each resolution level separately to maintain multiresolution capability, while exploiting spatial redundancy by creating vectors from pixels in the three detail levels surrounding every pixel in the lowest resolution image.
summary: Hybrid Vector Quantization is a multiresolution compression scheme that applies Vector Quantization to each resolution level separately while exploiting spatial redundancy by creating vectors from pixels in the three detail levels surrounding every pixel in the lowest resolution image.
